mechanical.reason: The original writes \textrm{try_kuhn}, which KaTeX cannot render because of the bare underscore in text mode; the translation uses \texttt{try\_kuhn} for the same identifier, so the mathematics and code are unchanged.

log.notes: The problem statement asked for the 'maximal' matching instead of the maximum one, the same slip was in the closing note on vertex cover; also a simple path was described as 'edgeless' instead of 'without repeated vertices or edges'. All three now follow the original.
Applied the glossary term 'juftlashtirish' for 'matching' throughout (kept 'matching' once as a gloss at the definition) and fixed 'Dirichlet prinsipi' to the glossary spelling 'Dirixle prinsipi'.
Only the inline \textrm{try_kuhn} formulas differ, rewritten as \texttt{try\_kuhn} so that KaTeX renders them; the code blocks are identical to the original.
